query.statement: /* OrderD.xml_001 */ SELECT A.ORDER_NO /* 주문번호 */ , A.ORDER_AMT /* 주문금액 */ , B.CUST_NM /* 고객명 */ FROM TB_ORDER A JOIN TB_CUSTOMER B ON B.CUST_ID = A.CUST_ID WHERE A.ORDER_DT >= :fromDt #if($status && $status != "ALL") AND A.STATUS = :status #elseif($catg == "A") AND A.CATG = 'A' #else AND A.CATG <> 'A' #end
